termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: Thanks for using VoxStudio. By installing, signing up for, or using the VoxStudio software (the "Service"), you agree to the terms below.

sections.title: 1. Account
sections.body: You must provide a valid email for verification. You're responsible for keeping your account and password secure. One account is for one individual — no sharing.

sections.title: 2. Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree to use VoxStudio only for lawful purposes. Forbidden: creating impersonation deepfakes without consent; producing copyright-infringing content; harassment, fraud, or spreading misinformation.

sections.title: 3. Content ownership
sections.body: You retain full ownership of any video, audio, voice clones you create or process via VoxStudio. We don't store or claim any license over your content. You're responsible for clearing rights on the source content before processing.

sections.title: 4. Voice cloning consent
sections.body: By cloning someone's voice, you confirm you have their consent. Violations may result in account suspension and legal liability.

sections.title: 5. Payments & refunds
sections.body: Paid plans activate after our team confirms the bank transfer (minutes to hours). You're entitled to a full 100% refund within 7 days if you're not satisfied — just reply to the receipt email. After 7 days, monthly plans are non-refundable (but you can cancel auto-renewal). Lifetime deals (LTD) are refundable within 14 days.

sections.title: 6. Limitation of liability
sections.body: VoxStudio is provided "as is". We're not liable for indirect damages from using the software. Our maximum liability is capped at what you've paid us in the trailing 12 months.

sections.title: 7. Changes to terms
sections.body: We may update these terms. Material changes are notified by email at least 14 days before they take effect.

sections.title: 8. Contact
sections.body: For any questions about these terms, email voxstudio.vn@gmail.com.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: VoxStudio is committed to protecting your privacy. This document explains what we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it.

sections.title: 1. What we collect
sections.body: On sign-up: email, hashed password, display name. During use: usage timing, current plan, dub/download counts (for quotas). We do NOT collect: video content, audio files, voice clones, transcripts. All of this stays on your machine.

sections.title: 2. Cookies & telemetry
sections.body: The app does not enable telemetry by default. This website uses essential cookies only (theme, language). No ad tracking, no data sales to third parties.

sections.title: 3. BYOK — your API keys
sections.body: When you enter API keys (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, ...) into the app, the keys are stored ENCRYPTED locally on your machine. They are never sent to VoxStudio servers.

sections.title: 4. Payments
sections.body: We process payments via Vietnamese domestic bank transfer. You provide a reference code in the transfer memo — we reconcile manually. We do NOT store credit card information.

sections.title: 5. Email
sections.body: We email you for: account verification, password reset, payment confirmation, important maintenance notices. You cannot opt out of these technical emails — they are required to operate the service.

sections.title: 6. Storage & deletion
sections.body: Account data is stored on servers located in Vietnam. When you delete your account, all your personal data is hard-deleted within 30 days. Payment history is retained for 5 years per accounting requirements.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to: view your personal data, correct it, delete your account, file a complaint with a data protection authority. Contact voxstudio.vn@gmail.com to exercise these rights.

sections.title: 8. Children under 13
sections.body: VoxStudio is not directed at users under 13. If you discover we have collected data from a minor without guardian consent, please email us so we can remove it immediately.
